description:
Perform a forensic data integrity check using Benford's Law on the provided population dataset.

1. Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/population_2018.csv' in JASP.
2. Activate the 'Audit' module (click the '+' icon in the top-right module ribbon and check 'Audit').
3. Select 'Audit' > 'Benford's Law'.
4. Assign the 'Value' column to the 'Variable' field.
5. Under 'Plots', enable the 'Observed vs. expected' plot.
6. Save the analysis as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/benford_analysis.jasp'.
